notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.66.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Dim tong cach dau truc 3 mm giay, dim chuoi cach dau truc 9 mm giay (cach dim tong 6 mm), ve phia cong trinh; nhan theo ty le view (1/150 -> 450 mm / 1350 mm). Khong con dim de len / trung / nam ngoai ky hieu dau truc. - Keo dau truc (2D hoac 3D) tren mat bang, mat dung, mat cat -> dim truc tu doi theo ngay trong lenh keo (1 lan Undo). - Bam lai nut Dim truc (hoac Mat bang chinh / Mat dung chinh): dim truc da co duoc doi ve dung vi tri, khong tao trung. - Chi doi dim ma moi diem do deu la truc; dim lan tuong / cot giu nguyen.
